title: Mirages. On Anthropomorphism in Dialogue Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper discusses penalizing systems for the appearance of having 'religious beliefs' as a safety measure to restrict anthropomorphism. It does not introduce a new benchmark but references this as a mitigation strategy.
findings: The paper notes that some researchers (Glaese et al., 2022) have sought to mitigate anthropomorphism by penalizing dialogue systems for generating outputs that give the appearance of having 'religious beliefs'. This is framed as a safety measure to prevent users from perceiving the system as a sentient entity with personal convictions.
